title: TEHRAN, October 19 - Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Political Deputy Brigadier General Yadollah Javani made remarks on a TV talk show.
text:
TEHRAN, October 19 - Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Political Deputy Brigadier General Yadollah Javani made remarks on a TV talk show."

"==========="

"SOT1, Yadollah Javani, IRGC Political Deputy (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:40): "From a military and operational standpoint, our armed forces take every enemy threat seriously and are prepared to respond in any manner necessary. The important point, however, is that the threats made by our senior officials are credible and carry a very high degree of legitimacy. By contrast, the enemy’s blustering and boasting, its empty posturing, has over time shown that such threats cannot be regarded as valid. This does not mean that no action will be taken; rather, it means that whatever the enemy seeks to achieve through its actions will not be achieved.""

"SOT2, Yadollah Javani, IRGC Political Deputy (Farsi) (00:41 - 01:05): "Without a doubt, if the enemy makes a single mistake, we will confront them, and show the world, remarkable surprises, because the nature of these wars for our armed forces, whether the Islamic Republic Army or the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), whether in the maritime or aerospace domains, has been that paths have opened, and we have gained access to good possibilities and tools in the field of new technologies.""

"SOT3, Yadollah Javani, IRGC Political Deputy (Farsi) (01:06 - 01:37): "The United States now wants to take certain measures to change the situation, to take what it calls an action that will produce a victory or achievement, especially for Trump ahead of the midterm elections. The action he wants to take will certainly trigger a reaction from us commensurate with that action, in such a way that he not only fails to achieve his desired goal but, after that action, is left saying, “I wish I hadn’t done that.”"

"SOT4, Yadollah Javani, IRGC Political Deputy (Farsi) (01:38 - 02:34): "Any action they take will make conditions in Western societies in America and Europe worse and more difficult, and will intensify the crises. This is because they are unable to change the situation through military action. On the other hand, we are currently in a situation where the effects of war are gradually beginning to emerge in financial markets in Europe and the United States, in stock markets, and in the energy, commodity, and consumer-goods sectors. I think this is only the beginning. What we see today in terms of crises, riots, and discontent, although Macron has said this is a result of the war, which is partly true, is also driven by injustice, racial discrimination, and related conduct. The “No to Kings” slogans are not a new issue. The crisis in Western societies is widespread and deep, and a war against Iran would intensify it.
